Description

Thirtyonejane is seeking a Remote E-Commerce & Shopify UX Strategist to join our growing team in the apparel and fashion industry. This full-time, remote position is based in Charlotte and offers an exciting opportunity to shape compelling digital shopping experiences across our e-commerce platforms.

In this entry-level role, you will help define and execute UX strategies that elevate our Shopify storefront, improve conversion, and create a seamless customer journey. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand customer behavior, optimize product presentation, and ensure that every touchpoint reflects the modern, fashion-forward identity of Thirtyonejane. .

As a key contributor to our e-commerce growth, you will play an important role in turning user insights into impactful design decisions, enhancing site usability, and driving online sales. We offer a competitive salary range of $90,000–$120,000 USD per year, along with the flexibility to work remotely while making a meaningful impact in a fast-moving fashion brand.

Responsibilities
Develop and implement e-commerce UX strategies aligned with Thirtyonejane’s brand vision and business goals
Audit and optimize Shopify storefront layouts, navigation, and product pages to improve user experience
Collaborate with marketers, designers, and merchandisers to create cohesive digital campaigns and product launches
Analyze customer journeys and identify friction points across the e-commerce funnel
Translate user research, heatmaps, and analytics data into actionable UX improvements
Support A/B testing initiatives to optimize conversion rates and engagement
Ensure mobile responsiveness and accessibility best practices across all pages
Help maintain consistent branding, messaging, and visual hierarchy in a Shopify environment
Monitor e-commerce trends, Shopify features, and competitor strategies to inform UX decisions
Work with developers to implement UX recommendations and ensure design integrity
Assist in creating wireframes, mockups, or prototypes to communicate UX concepts effectively
Requirements
Passion for e-commerce, UX design, and the apparel/fashion industry
Foundational understanding of Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms
Entry-level experience with UX principles, user-centered design, or conversion optimization
Ability to analyze customer behavior using analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics, or similar platforms
Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration
Detail-oriented approach with a focus on creating intuitive digital experiences
Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies or e-commerce optimization concepts
Basic understanding of visual design principles, including layout, typography, and color
$90,000–$120,000
